name: comparison-header-both-markers-together-are-unclassifiable
description: The middle row of the three-way rule, and the whole reason the rule is three-way rather than a predicate. A line carrying BOTH the journal type marker and an entry kind is not classified at all: never absorbed as a header (which would silently lose an entry), never a reason to refuse the file (which would be an uncontracted version-skew refusal of everything). It is skipped and reported naming the ambiguity — a location claim about this build's ability to read the line, NOT a verdict about what the line is, which is exactly what this build cannot know. Both obvious repairs fail in opposite directions; admitting a third verdict is what makes the reader stop having to choose between two wrong certainties.
